title: Contain unreconciled Balance Sheet reliance
tests: dated Balance Sheet/P&L/Trial Balance fixture; warning/availability authorization E2E
acceptance: Known failing periods are clearly controlled and reconciled; no false balanced status.

title: Approve currency, scale, rounding and recognition contract
tests: precision boundary/property suite; JSON Go/JS serialization parity
acceptance: Named accountant/owner signs versioned currency, tax, rounding and recognition rules.

title: Define journal and immutable posting invariants
tests: balanced/one-sided line unit suite; posted immutability and closed-period integration
acceptance: Policy and schema reject unbalanced/ineligible/duplicate posting with no partial effects.

title: Default journal attachments to valid JSON
tests: browser omitted attachments; PostgreSQL [] and malformed JSON
acceptance: Default draft persists valid JSONB and invalid payload is controlled.

title: Reject material auto-post imbalance
tests: Dr100/Cr90 rejects; reverse imbalance rejects; approved rounding attribution fixture
acceptance: No material difference changes a business line; approved rounding explicit only.

title: Initialize auto-post JSONB attachments
tests: every auto-post event inserts attachments []; failure visible
acceptance: Automatic journal inserts valid JSON and posting outcomes remain visible.

title: Align auto-post entry types with schema
tests: all declared types against PostgreSQL schema; forward migration from prior schema
acceptance: All supported values fit enforced contract; historical rows preserved.

title: Make posting intent durable and recoverable
files: DISCOVERY REQUIRED: source transaction, outbox/inbox, worker, migrations
tests: crash at commit/publish/ack boundaries; duplicate event/concurrent worker
acceptance: At-least-once delivery yields one journal effect and visible retry/terminal state.

title: Expose and reconcile paid-order posting outcome
tests: inject sales/COGS failures; paid event retry idempotency
acceptance: A paid order cannot silently appear financially complete without sales/COGS disposition.

title: Prove all order/tender/refund channels
files: DISCOVERY REQUIRED: current POS/web/admin payment paths

title: Reconcile inventory, supplier and AR/AP subledgers
files: DISCOVERY REQUIRED: inventory and invoice integrations
tests: receipt/COGS/waste and control-account fixtures; aging reconciliation
acceptance: Quantity/value and invoice subledgers reconcile to their GL controls.

title: Repair earnings and Balance Sheet equation
tests: four historical dated fixtures; earnings close/cutoff and TB bridge
acceptance: Assets=liabilities+equity at all approved cutoffs, including current-period earnings.

title: Reconcile all financial reports to ledger watermark
tests: P&L, cash flow, aging, VAT, inventory and consolidation independent fixtures
acceptance: All statements agree to posted ledger and documented policy.

title: Prove tenant/RBAC isolation for finance
tests: two-tenant BOLA/BFLA role matrix; cache/job scope cases
acceptance: All unauthorized object and export attempts deny with no data leakage.

title: Prove export format, parity and safety
tests: CSV/PDF/native XLSX reader tests; formula injection and large streaming
acceptance: Export format is real, authorized and reconciles exactly to screen/watermark.

title: Measure financial workload and capacity
files: No optimization until profiling; exact files DISCOVERY REQUIRED
acceptance: Owner-approved SLOs met under representative measured workload.

title: Run commercial financial release evidence suite
acceptance: Authorized GO decision with no financial/security NO-GO condition.
